name: Website Info
author: hvantech

sections.description:
Website Info is a comprehensive and professional dashboard plugin that provides administrators with essential information about their WordPress website in one convenient location. This plugin displays detailed information about WordPress installation, plugins, server configuration, and security status.

Key Features

🎯 WordPress Information
* Current WordPress version
* Multisite status
* Language and timezone settings
* Debug mode status

🔌 Plugin Management Dashboard
* Complete list of active plugins with details
* Inactive plugins overview
* Plugin statistics and percentages
* Author and version information for each plugin

🔒 SSL Security Status
* Real-time SSL certificate status
* Site URL security verification
* Force SSL admin panel detection

🖥️ Server Information
* PHP version and configuration
* MySQL/MariaDB version
* Server software details
* Memory limits and execution time
* Upload size limitations
* Server IP and document root

🎨 Beautiful Interface
* Modern, responsive design
* WordPress admin color scheme
* Smooth animations and transitions
* Mobile and tablet friendly
* Clean, organized layout

Why Choose Website Info?

✅ Easy to Use – No configuration required, works immediately after activation
✅ Secure – Only administrators can access the information
✅ Lightweight – No database storage, minimal resource usage
✅ Professional – Clean, modern interface that fits WordPress admin
✅ Comprehensive – All essential information in one place

Perfect For

  • Website Administrators who need quick access to site information
  • Developers working on WordPress projects
  • Support Teams troubleshooting website issues
  • Agencies managing multiple WordPress sites
  • Anyone who wants to monitor their website’s technical status

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/website-info/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Access ‘Website Info’ from the admin sidebar menu
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store any data in the database?

No, the plugin only displays information and doesn’t store anything in the database.

Can regular users access this information?

No, only users with Administrator role can access the Website Info dashboard.

Does it affect website performance?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only loads on the admin dashboard when accessed.

Is it compatible with multisite?

Yes, the plugin works with both single sites and multisite installations.

Can I customize the appearance?

The plugin uses WordPress admin styling and adapts to your admin color scheme.
